newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends weaker and within range.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends weaker and within range.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures closed a see-saw session lower, with the speculators noted as the main sellers and the trade a steady scale down buyer, dealers said.

The benchmark March contract reached a high of 10.46 where it formed a double top shortly after the open. Unable to break through resistance beginning at 10.47, the contract plunged to the day's low of 10.23 cents.
Speculative short-covering lifted the March contract towards the day's high by midsession, but trade selling once again pressured the market to the lows.
March ended down 0.08 at 10.33, traded 10.46 to 10.23 cents. The back months settled 0.05 to 0.07 lower. Volume was estimated at 18,7434 lots.
Dealers expect prices to remain in the current range between 10.23 and 10.46 basis March until the contract's expiry next month. Thursday, prices are seen recouping losses.
"From here we could go up," a trader said, noting that the funds are heavily short and will look to cover positions.
"Of course, no news at all is keeping the market in this range," he said.
Resistance remained at the gap on the charts between 10.47 and 10.50 in March and then between 10.70 and 10.80. Support below 10.23 was seen at the recent low of 10.10 cents.
